title: Драка в зале и мёртвые рыбки  (Brawl in the Dining Room and the Dead Fish)

segments.t: To Vasily's amusement, a full-blown brawl breaks out in the dining room, prompting Vika to strip Senya of his monthly bonus. Worse still, Sasha and Kostya horrifiedly discover that Max killed the aquarium fish Ilya had gifted her, and Kostya tells Max to leave.
Что ты с салатами в зале жонглировал?
Значит, в этом месяце работаешь без премии.
Костян, я должен был ему отомстить.
Let's replay the exchange and look closely at each Russian phrase.
'Although what kind of restaurant is this, anyway?' Asking whether although what kind of restaurant is this anyway puts Kostya right on the defensive.
'Naked men running through the dining room.' With the work and fish in play, Vika keeps this short reply brisk and direct.
Что ты с салатами в зале жонглировал?

'Why were you juggling salads out in the dining room?' Wondering why Max juggling salads out in the dining room was cuts straight through the tension between Kostya and Max. Speaking with the close, informal "you" strips away any polite distance between them.
'You red-headed clown.' Over the work and the fish, Max answers Kostya without a second thought.
Значит, в этом месяце работаешь без премии.
'That means you are working without a bonus this month.' Because that means Kostya is working without a bonus this month, Vika treats the matter as settled.

'Did everyone hear that?' By checking whether everyone hear, Kostya presses Max for a straight answer. In Russian, he does not need helper words like "do" or "did"—rising pitch alone turns it into a question.
'Right, Vika?' With the room and moment hanging in the air, Max puts Kostya on the spot.
'My guests are going to walk out.' Claiming that her guests are going to walk out sounds confident, even if Kostya has doubts.
'What a madhouse.' With the point and fish in play, Kostya keeps this short reply brisk and direct.
Костян, я должен был ему отомстить.
'Kostyan, I had to get back at him.' Max explains that someone he had to get back at him, keeping his voice calm and direct.
'Oh, stop whining.' Stopping whining is how Vika lays out the situation for Kostya. Speaking with the close, informal "you" strips away any polite distance between them.
'Did you kill them?' Asking whether Max kills them is how Kostya puts Max on the spot. Using the informal "you" shows how direct and unfiltered their kitchen relationship is.
'Max, you had better leave.' Even though Kostya had better leave, Max keeps a steady face in front of Kostya. Let's hear the complete conversation once more.
Что ты с салатами в зале жонглировал?
Значит, в этом месяце работаешь без премии.
Костян, я должен был ему отомстить.
That wraps up this scene as a wild brawl erupts in the dining room to Vasily's delight, while Sasha and Kostya discover that Max poisoned the aquarium fish Ilya gave to Sasha. Until next time!
